title: Restricted Fixed-Weir Transactional Runtime Candidate

source_authority.later_delta: governance-only F-CI41P status; no production-source delta

architecture.persistent_state: Dedicated fmr_b110_fixed_weir_surface_water_state_t subclass. Only active columns carry SWST; inactive base-state layout is unchanged.
architecture.surface_water_state: Exactly one physical continuation scalar: storage (SWST). Water level is derived from the qualified level/storage mapping and is not separately persisted.
architecture.parameters: Feature-scoped immutable fixed-weir parameter registry outside the base soil parameter object.
architecture.forcing: Feature-scoped surface-water forcing carries authoritative secondary-drainage scalar and external supply capacity; drainage node field remains Richards-only transient composition scratch.
architecture.numerics: Feature-scoped fixed-weir numerical config remains separate from physical parameters/forcing and from the generic canonical numerical contract.
architecture.transaction_path: Reuse the existing fmr_execute_serialized_resolved_physical_column -> kernel transaction -> canonical interval route. No second commit authority is introduced.
architecture.worker_context: A D7 wrapper configures worker-local surface-water context before invoking the existing resolved executor and clears it afterwards.
architecture.mass_accounting: When D7 is active, node drainage is internal soil-to-surface-water transfer and is excluded from external ledger. SWST gains the authoritative scalar transfer. Only supply is external-in and fixed-weir discharge is external-out. Scalar/node disagreement therefore remains visible as a hard transaction mass residual.
architecture.temporal_policy: D7 admits only TX_TEMPORAL_EXTERNAL_FULL_HALF. Existing non-surface-water physical identity must remain exact; surface-water temporal error is abs(SWST_full - SWST_two_half). TX_TEMPORAL_MODEL_CERTIFICATE is held because the current model certificate covers Richards only.
architecture.restart: The existing serialization-neutral committed-state persistence can carry the D7 state subclass without a byte-format/schema change, but restart admission must bind the state subclass to an explicit optional_state_layout_id and reject mismatched profiles.
architecture.snow_composition: Held from the first D7 candidate to avoid an unqualified combined optional-state topology. D7 active requires snow inactive.
architecture.negative_drainage: Held. The restricted candidate accepts nonnegative secondary drainage only.

required_candidate_tests: active one-step combined soil+SWST mass closure
inactive path preserves legacy external drainage accounting
rejected/infeasible trial cannot mutate committed SWST
checkpoint retry starts from the same committed SWST
accepted commit publishes SWST exactly once
restart export/restore preserves SWST and rejects optional-layout mismatch
O0/O2 identity for the D7 candidate route
qualification_boundary: This design and subsequent owner tests can establish a structural/runtime candidate only. Scientific equivalence, independent qualification and canonical admission require separate downstream evidence.
